tokenizer.name: unicode-word-punct
tokenizer.definition: Unicode letter/number runs or one non-whitespace punctuation character; offsets are preserved.

common.raw_text_policy: source-faithful text or deterministic table linearization
common.fallback_policy: emit audit sample with retrieval_eligible=false and fact_eligible=false
common.table_linearization: cells joined by ' | '; rows joined by newline
common.dedup_policy: content_sha256 first; repeated-section policy is measured before full embedding

strategies.long_table_policy: linearize rows, then apply the same token windows
strategies.section_context: not injected into raw_text; metadata only

strategies.long_paragraph_policy: token window split inside a section
strategies.long_table_policy: row-preserving section windows; an overlong row is token-split
strategies.table_metadata: section path, table node ID, row/column spans

strategies.long_paragraph_policy: paragraph groups first; overlong paragraph is token-split
strategies.long_table_policy: TABLE_WHOLE parent windows plus row-preserving TABLE_ROW children; overlong row is token-split
strategies.section_context: section/event parent title included in embed_text
strategies.table_metadata: caption/unit/period/scope hints plus row/column source spans
strategies.auxiliary_table_row_policy: unit/date/navigation-only rows are stored under TABLE_WHOLE but are not indexed independently

document_type_policies.periodic: section parent -> paragraph child; table whole parent -> table row child
document_type_policies.major: event/item parent -> paragraph or field-group child; table dual representation
document_type_policies.exchange: contract/investment event parent -> field-group child; table dual representation
document_type_policies.holding: reporter/holding-status parent -> holding-row child; table dual representation

strategies.conditional_extension: repeated-section penalty is applied only after duplicate-budget measurement
